briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ +0.5% and S&P 500 +0.3% — no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold anyway, so we held all 7 positions rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: On neutral market days, disciplined investors avoid forcing trades just to deploy idle cash. Waiting for a genuine multi-signal setup — like a MACD crossover paired with strong volume — leads to better entries than acting out of impatience.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 在市場方向不明的日子，有紀律的投資者不會為了運用閒置現金而勉強交易。耐心等待真正的多重訊號確認（例如MACD黃金交叉配合成交量放大），往往能帶來更好的入市時機，而非因心急而行動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.5% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. Volume and volatility stayed muted, consistent with investors waiting for clearer signals before committing new capital. No single headline dominated trading, which is itself typical of a neutral, low-conviction market day.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢溫和向上，納指升0.5%，標普500指數升0.3%，市場缺乏明顯方向，交投淡靜。成交量及波幅均維持低位，反映投資者在等待更明確的訊號才願意加碼。今日並無單一消息主導市場，屬於典型的中性、低信心交易日。
